evidenceBasis: m7 third screening (3aaec879, descriptive): lanes standard with the shipped knobs (I0 60.8, HI0 63.7) and the knobs alone (M7_D 63.2) did not fix m7; both together did (I 44.8, M 47.8, L 49.5); invasion and tower effects were within noise. three_lane_pressure shares the lanes group, the fast tempo and early aggressive with m7 but not the invasion (jungle gank, invadePriority 0.15) and starts on lower knobs (0.7 / 0.6). classic.m1 has one aggressive lane (mid) and the highest tower priority (0.9); round 1 did not reproduce m1 (54.0 vs G-A8 60.3) and M1_A (aggression 0.55) did nothing. These are hypotheses for the arm list, not evidence of a fix

candidateRules: every numeric value stays inside the range the eight classic templates and three overlays already cover (template rule 1); enum values are existing values

thresholds: the G-A8 rules, unchanged: STOP = win rate >= 0.60 and lower 95% bound > 0.55; WARN strong >= 0.57; WARN weak <= 0.43; control 0.50 +/- 0.05
selectionRule: unchanged from rounds 1-3, per template: a candidate qualifies only inside the band 0.43 < win rate < 0.57 (an overshoot to the weak side never qualifies)
SELECTED: the first qualifying candidate in the listed order with 0.45 <= win rate <= 0.55; a qualifying candidate only in 0.43-0.45 or 0.55-0.57 => SELECTED_BORDERLINE; none => NO_CANDIDATE

review #4: when BASE is not reproduced on this block (the tool rule), the tool sets the verdict NOT_REPRODUCED and selected = null; the candidate appears only as screenedCandidate / screenedVerdict and is descriptive. Whether m1 needs a fix at all is an Owner decision from the three blocks (G-A8 60.3, round 1 54.0, this block)
a BORDERLINE or a selection that needs a redesign-level copy change (TLP_C0 / C / D, M1_E0 / E / F) goes to the Owner as an explicit decision; nothing is changed by this study

review #1 (stricter, registered before the run; the tool is unchanged): the selection rule looks at the candidate rate only, not at its difference to BASE, and both BASEs sat close to the band on their last block (three_lane_pressure 57.25, m1 54.0), so an ineffective early arm can land in 0.45-0.55 by noise. Therefore: a SELECTED or BORDERLINE candidate is reported as SHOWS_IMPROVEMENT only if its paired vsBase upper 95% bound is < 0, otherwise as IN_BAND_NOT_DISTINGUISHED_FROM_BASE; per template the report also names the first candidate in the listed order whose vsBase upper bound is < 0 (FIRST_DISTINGUISHED); if the selected candidate is not distinguished and a later one is, both go to the Owner. Only a SHOWS_IMPROVEMENT candidate is described as improving balance

review #5: three_lane_pressure has no arm that keeps its identity and its risk label together: TLP_A / B move to std knobs (高 -> 中) and TLP_C0 / C / D remove the three-lane forward stance that names the template. If TLP_A and TLP_B are not selected, every remaining fix is a redesign, not a balance adjustment, and a NO_CANDIDATE means no balance-level fix was found among these arms
